verdict.unit: defects fixed in the harbourmaster skill
verdict.headline: A near-full swap file made a Mac with 54 GB free look out of memory, and the governor refused all work.

tasks.title: A near-full swap file made the Mac look out of memory
tasks.note: the kernel's own pressure reading decides it now; swap is kept as evidence

tasks.title: The berth rules doc still described a bug that had been fixed
tasks.note: it promised 6 berths where the code allows 3 when a reading fails

tasks.title: An error message told you to run a flag that does not exist
tasks.note: install.sh --thermal-read was never a flag; it is --grants

tasks.title: A slowed-down process would never have been sped back up
tasks.note: it waited on the disk reading, which this Mac can never satisfy

tasks.title: Speeding a process back up could hit the wrong process
tasks.note: macOS reuses process numbers; each one now records its start time too

tasks.title: Two lanes crashed instead of reporting, under the very load they watch for
tasks.note: the slowdown detector and the thermal lane now return empty rather than raising

tasks.title: A bad event record crashed the journal writer
tasks.note: malformed input now exits with a message

tasks.title: Process families are matched against the whole command line
tasks.note: measured at 2 wrong matches in 112, both already caught by another guard
tasks.blocked_by: not worth a change at that size; left with the measurement recorded

findings.claim: a process family is matched anywhere in the command line, so an argument can stand in for the program
the invented-flag guard does not cover install.sh, which is how the bad flag survived
